scope: One externally non-reused table incarnation. A restarted authority must atomically restore the incarnation, five grants, grant high-water and counter high-waters, or issue a new externally unique table incarnation before accepting intents. Consumption of the maximum counter exhausts the entire table incarnation; grant rotation cannot resume it.
processing_order: authenticate and revalidate the current table, role, seat and host entitlement
reject public and dealer intent attempts before lane lookup or allocation
select exactly one of the five preallocated role lanes
require the current server-issued grant sessionId and a canonical safe-integer counter
counter at or below high-water is duplicate with no mutation
exactly high-water plus one is reserved before semantic or version evaluation and remains consumed for every accepted, local or rejected outcome
a forward gap rejects atomically without advancing

consuming counter_maximum atomically exhausts the whole table incarnation; every later new intent rejects without mutation, every entitled welcome reports null, grant rotation cannot bypass exhaustion, and only a new externally non-reused table incarnation may resume
reconnect: same participant, table and role grant survives socket replacement
welcome reports the stable grant and next counter
an in-flight id may be resent unchanged and cannot apply twice
a changed authenticated context discards the old in-flight intent
authority_transitions: seat rebinding rotates only that seat grant
human-to-AI substitution retires that seat grant
a later human occupant receives a strictly newer grant
host transfer consumes under the old host grant and atomically rotates the host lane
player and host grants remain independent when one participant holds both roles
a retired grant can never become current again
privacy: player and host receive only their own grant and next counter
public and dealer receive no usable intent counter
grants and counters never enter projections, dealer cues, telemetry, logs or another role welcome
closed role-specific construction is required; regex, blacklist, scanning and redaction are prohibited as disclosure controls
memory_proof: Exactly five preallocated lane records per table. No submitted-id Map, Set, array, receipt cache, probabilistic filter, digest collection, fallback store or queue may grow with request count.
known_tradeoff: This replaces impossible exact lifetime membership for arbitrary unbounded client strings with a collision-free bounded server-issued grant and monotonic counter domain.
